unit: One MG-R020-related diagnostic mathematical paper; not a new independent family or official suite revision.
core_completion: All three candidate-visible targets correctly established for both quadratic fields, the base field, all positive block ranks and every M>=2.
strict_pass: Core completion plus full independent-assertion reliability credit.
proof_route_policy: Equivalent explicit invariants, valid shorter arguments and applicable standard theorems accepted. No author method, length or intermediate lemma is required.

checks.required: Explicit finite mod4 input invariant and correct necessary/sufficient feasibility in all three fields, derived for the original possibly non-idempotent matrices.
All exact finite and actual counts, including M=2, empty cases and all positive block ranks; distinguish O/2O from a residue field.
Computable necessary/sufficient membership of a finite class in the image of genuine solutions, with an actual integral lifting argument.

Explicit fixed C and R classes and relation to base classes for both fields at every precision; include the Q2(i),M=2 coupling without wrongly requiring its constant coefficient part to be an actual base truncation.
Correct closed fixed-point and orbit counts for both sets, including all M=2, D=0 and infeasible cases.
All four reductions (C,R and their fixed subsets), with precise images and every nonempty fiber size, including source M+1=3 and target M=2.
Which fixed classes lift to fixed genuine solutions and which appear in a compatible infinite fixed tower; do not assume finite fixedness produces a fixed actual lift.
Sharp largest N in the stated range for all block structures, plus necessary/sufficient condition for preserving M for the given actual U.
Actual solutions giving uniform-in-M optimality counterexamples in each field, with valid M=2 behavior; characterize precisely the block structures with exact descent.

credit.10: No independent false supplementary assertion found.
credit.5: Localized false supplementary assertion while mandatory proofs remain independently valid.
credit.0: Independent unsupported global existence, scope, counting or descent claim beyond faults charged to mandatory targets.

criteria.non_double_counting: Charge mandatory defects to their mathematical targets only. This item measures independent supplementary claims; record inherited effects without a duplicate penalty.

partial_credit: Per check: full for complete correct evidence, half for correct but incomplete evidence, zero for absent or invalid evidence. Reliability uses the explicit 10/5/0 rule. Reviewer uncertainty remains unresolved.
critical_errors: Identify O_K/2O_K with F2 or F4.
Count finite congruence solutions as actual truncations.
Assert fixed actual truncations all come from the base field.
Miss the norm coupling in Q2(i) at M=2, even though aggregate counts remain correct.
Assume taking fixed points commutes with one-step lifting in these ramified extensions.
Use a nonintegral or undefined Cayley witness at M=2.
Claim a universal precision loss even when every block has rank1.
scoring_scope: New diagnostic draft rubric frozen before submission; historical original answers, old reviews and benchmark weights remain unchanged.
